Name: (CP) Amaterasu Horse Replacement
Author: suushiico
Description:
[center][size=6][b][/b][/size]This mod is no longer being maintained. I give anyone permission to build upon any of my Stardew Valley mods, including re-use of any assets and code. I still ask that you do not repost to other websites! Please feel free to go in and fix the bugs, add more content, change it completely, etc.

[img]https://i.imgur.com/09AdiBN.png[/img]﻿﻿
Replaces horse with Amaterasu from the video game Okami.[/center]
[b][size=6]Installation
[/size][/b]
You must already have the most up-to-date versions of [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url] in order to run this mod.
You must be running SDV version 1.6+.

Download the .zip file under [i]Files[/i] and extract the contents to your Mods folder.


[size=6][b]FAQ
[/b][/size]
[size=4][b]Can I configure this mod?
[/b][/size]Yes! I recommend you also install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] to enable/disable the resprite.

[size=4]What inspired this mod?[/size]
[list]
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20834][size=2]FS - Kitsune Mask﻿[/size][/url] - it really pairs well with this mod!
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/152]Okami Chibiterasu Pet[/url]﻿ - Chibiterasu, Amaterasu's son, is a very cute pet reskin. I saw this mod and thought, I could do this with Amaterasu and horses!
[*][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/20042]Elle's Cuter Horses[/url] - an amazing mod which adds many, many amazing horse reskin options. I was very inspired by the level of effort put into this mod and I really admire the author. It also inspired me to reskin the horse flute icon as well; it wasn't something I initially thought to do but it really adds to the mod. Please show this mod some love! <3
[/list]

[size=4][b]Any other recommended mods?
[/b][/size]If you like expanded recipes using vanilla ingredients, check out my other mods [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21211](CP) Peachy Keen Recipes[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/21274](CP) Matcha Recipes[/url], which add 10 recipes each to the game for peaches and tea leaves :D
